rebuttal_or_critique: I remain unconvinced by the committee's insistence on maintaining a 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance. With core inflation at 3.10%, the real policy rate is excessively high, and the current stance is no longer data-consistent. Monetary policy cannot and should not attempt to solve supply-side food price shocks at the cost of broader economic growth. A 25 bps cut and a shift to neutral are essential to prevent the policy rate from becoming a persistent drag on the 6.80% GVA growth momentum.
